analyst.summary: KPI Green Energy is a fast-growing Gujarat renewable-power developer (solar and wind, IPP plus captive-power models) that has compounded revenue at 55%+ over the past year on an expanding roughly 4.7 GW capacity base and a large project pipeline (3.61 GW order book). But margins today are still driven mostly by lower-quality EPC/construction revenue rather than mature annuity power generation, the flagship Khavda project has seen commissioning delays, and the promoter has both pledged a large share of holdings and diluted existing shareholders via a fresh warrant issue to fund growth. We rate it a Hold: the growth pipeline is genuine, but at this valuation the execution and governance risks are not yet fully proven out, so this is one to watch rather than add to.
